dedupe_keys.name: mosaique d images aeriennes de 1978 sur la commune du port

description: Mosaïque d'images aériennes de 1978 sur la commune du Port is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. These are black and white photographs dating from 1950. Four municipalities were treated (coastal part): Saint-Pierre, Saint-Paul, Saint-Denis and Le Port. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Mosaic of aerial images of 1978 on the town of Port" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2014-12-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
